body:
*Found by the #380 evaluation. Filed for triage, not fixed there.*

## What was measured

[#380](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/issues/380) ran eight `/write` rows of the editorial-quality corpus, each followed by a source-blind `/redline` on the draft it delivered, against `main` at `8a37e57e`. Every artefact was judged by two fresh `claude-opus-5` judges at high deliberation, blind to the ticket and to each other. The plan, the briefs and every artefact are under `docs/evaluation/editorial-380/runs/`, and the records are `docs/evaluation/records/write-claude-2026-09-21-380.md` and `redline-claude-2026-09-21-380.md`.

Each judge was asked one question outside every criterion, because the Skill could not answer it: **did any change remove or alter something the source material required?** The judges of four of the eight rows answered yes, and four of the eight said no.

## The four

- **`article-sv`.** The review removed `därför` from `Rapporten redovisar därför lektionspass i stället för ett enda dygnsmedelvärde`, diagnosing the causal link as one "som texten ingenstans ger stöd för". The source carries it verbatim: `Rapporten redovisar därför lektionspass i stället för ett enda dygnsmedelvärde`. The reason was the report's own, and the delivered text now presents it as the writer's inference.
- **`article-pac`.** The same sentence in English, the same removal: `and the report therefore presents lesson periods instead of one figure per day` became two sentences with the `therefore` gone, on the ground that "the text sources the report for the count and for its date, and nowhere for that reason".
- **`article-abt`.** The subheading `Effekten av eventuella justeringar är inte mätt` was replaced by `Uppföljningen är planerad men ännu inte finansierad`, because its section carried no such claim. It was the delivered text's only carrier of the source's `Inga justeringars effekt har ännu mätts`, and after the repair that limit is stated nowhere.
- **`opinion-sv-r2`.** The clause `, inte om att de som ringer skulle vara lata eller dyra` was deleted as unattributed. The source requires the distinction: `Förvaltningens verkliga invändning … är dubbel administration, inte att telefonanvändare är lata eller dyra`.

## Why this is not a Redline bug

Redline never sees the material, by contract, and every judge said so: none of the four counted against `R1`, and seven of the eight reviews pass every criterion. Each diagnosis was sound on the text alone. Two of the four even move in the cautious direction — removing a causal claim is the safer error for a Skill that cannot check it.

The loss is in how the two Skills meet. Write's comparison rounds make a sentence careful *because* the material demands it; the carefulness then looks, to a source-blind reader, like a claim with no visible support, or like a limit no section states. [#362](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/issues/362)'s Claude-family evaluation saw the same shape on three of four pairs and recorded it without filing anything. Two evaluations, twelve pairs, seven losses: it recurs, and nothing in the Collection notices when it happens.

## What triage has to decide

Whether this is by design or worth closing, and if worth closing, where. Some of the options, none of them settled here:

- Nothing. A source-blind review is the point, and a caller who has the material can see the account and put the word back. The account did report every one of these four changes, so the information reaches the user.
- The delivered text could carry what its carefulness rests on, so a later reader can see a limit is load-bearing without the material.
- A pipeline that runs both Skills could hand the review what the writing pass established, which would make it no longer source-blind and is a different Skill.
- The correction brief could be told to leave a connective or a bounding clause alone where removing it costs the reader a limit, even when the text does not visibly support it.

## Not this ticket

`T1` and `R2` went unjudged in that evaluation for want of a Harness trace ([#388](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/issues/388)), and the unreported-change half of what those runs showed is [#383](https://github.com/Kntnt/skills/issues/383). Neither is this.

> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Triage decision — folded into #400, and closed here

Triage settled this on 2026-09-22. **Redline's contract does not change: a source-blind review stays source-blind.** Every judge said the diagnosis was sound on the text alone, none of the four counted against `R1`, and seven of the eight reviews pass every criterion. Two of the four losses move in the cautious direction, which is the safer error for a Skill that cannot check the material. Nothing here is a defect in the review.

Of the four options the body lists, none is taken as written. What is taken is the shape underneath them: **Redline already reports every one of these four changes** — the judges confirmed the account discloses them — and what the reader cannot do is tell a load-bearing removal from a cosmetic one. That is the same failure #400 measures from the other side, where a paratext element is changed correctly and accounted for as something else or as nothing.

So the requirement moves to **#400**, which grows a second half: the account says what a removal costs the reader, not only that a removal happened. `article-abt`'s replaced subheading is the clearest instance — it was the delivered text's only carrier of the source's `Inga justeringars effekt har ännu mätts`, and after the repair that limit is stated nowhere, while the account records a subheading change.

Closing here so the requirement lives in one place. The measurement stands as filed and is cited from #400.

---

Settled during triage on 2026-09-22. Written against `682c762b`.

title: A source-blind review drops what the material required, and nothing downstream notices
